description: The AI-Powered Website Accessibility Checker project aims to develop an innovative tool that leverages artificial intelligence to assess websites for compliance with accessibility standards such as WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines). The AI algorithm will analyze various elements, including text readability, color contrast, alt text for images, and navigational ease. This project is crucial for businesses looking to enhance their digital presence and ensure inclusivity for all users, thereby meeting legal requirements and improving user experience. The final product will be user-friendly, allowing website owners to easily understand and implement the suggested changes.
